angle.attack.name: Attack
angle.attack.description: An ambush in the ring, backstage or in the car park. Few words, lots of impact.

angle.confrontation.name: Confrontation
angle.confrontation.description: Rivals come face to face. Words are traded and it may not stay peaceful.

angle.contract-signing.name: Contract Signing
angle.contract-signing.description: A table, a contract and two people who do not like each other. It rarely ends with just a signature.

angle.interview.name: Interview
angle.interview.description: A backstage or ringside interviewer asks the questions and the talent answers.

angle.promo.name: Promo
angle.promo.description: Someone takes the microphone and talks to the crowd, an opponent or the camera.

angle.video-package.name: Video Package
angle.video-package.description: A pre-recorded piece that builds a rivalry or introduces someone new.

match.battle-royal.name: Battle Royal
match.battle-royal.description: A crowded ring where going over the top rope eliminates you. The last one left wins. Loose work, but crowds enjoy the chaos.

match.endurance.name: Endurance Match
match.endurance.description: A long one-on-one contest that rewards conditioning and patient mat work.

match.four-way.name: Four-Way
match.four-way.description: Four workers, every one for themselves. The first fall ends it.

match.handicap.name: Handicap
match.handicap.description: Two sides of different sizes: one worker against two or three, or two against three.

match.singles.name: Singles
match.singles.description: One against one. The plainest test of two workers, and the base every other type is measured against.

match.sprint.name: Sprint
match.sprint.description: A short, fast one-on-one bout with no time to settle in.

match.tag-team.name: Tag Team
match.tag-team.description: Two pairs, one worker from each side legal at a time, with tags to change over.

match.trios.name: Six-Person Tag
match.trios.description: Two teams of three. Busy and fast, and a good way to get many people on a card.

match.triple-threat.name: Three-Way
match.triple-threat.description: Three workers, every one for themselves. The first fall ends it.

method.count-out.name: Count-Out
method.count-out.description: One side stays outside the ring past the referee's count.

method.disqualification.name: Disqualification
method.disqualification.description: One side breaks the rules badly enough that the referee awards the match to the other.

method.knockout.name: Knockout
method.knockout.description: The opponent cannot answer the referee's count.

method.pinfall.name: Pinfall
method.pinfall.description: Shoulders held to the mat for a three count.

method.referee-stoppage.name: Referee Stoppage
method.referee-stoppage.description: The referee ends the match because one side cannot go on safely.

method.submission.name: Submission
method.submission.description: The opponent gives up to a hold.

finish.cheating.name: Cheating finish
finish.cheating.summary: Feet on the ropes, a fistful of tights or a hidden object; the referee misses it.

finish.clean.name: Clean finish
finish.clean.summary: One side beats the other fair and square; nobody can argue with the result.

finish.controversial.name: Controversial finish
finish.controversial.summary: A missed kick-out or a fast count; the result stands but the crowd hates it.

finish.count-out.name: Count-out
finish.count-out.summary: One side stays outside too long and loses on the count; the title can't change hands.

finish.disqualification.name: Disqualification
finish.disqualification.summary: One side goes too far and the referee throws them out; the title can't change hands.

finish.double-count-out.name: Double count-out
finish.double-count-out.summary: Both sides brawl outside past the count and nobody wins.

finish.flash.name: Flash finish
finish.flash.summary: A sudden roll-up out of nowhere steals it before the match finds its stride.

finish.interference.name: Outside interference
finish.interference.summary: Someone from outside the match gets involved and swings it.

finish.no-contest.name: No contest
finish.no-contest.summary: The referee throws the match out; the title can't change hands.

finish.stalemate.name: Stalemate
finish.stalemate.summary: Neither side can put the other away and the referee calls it even.

beat.announcement.name: Announcement
beat.announcement.description: Someone with authority makes news: a match, a title shot or a change to the show.

beat.arrival.name: Arrival
beat.arrival.description: A camera catches someone walking into the building, bag on their shoulder and a look on their face.

beat.attack.name: Attack
beat.attack.description: One side jumps the other without warning. The attackers look dangerous and the targets earn sympathy.

beat.backstage-confrontation.name: Backstage Confrontation
beat.backstage-confrontation.description: Two sides run into each other in a corridor. Words fly and the crew has to step in.

beat.backstage-skit.name: Backstage Skit
beat.backstage-skit.description: A short scene backstage: a plot, a joke or a warning, filmed for the show.

beat.brawl.name: Brawl
beat.brawl.description: Everyone involved throws punches until the ring, the floor or the backstage area is a mess.

beat.celebration.name: Celebration
beat.celebration.description: A win, a title or a milestone is celebrated in front of the crowd.

beat.contract-signing.name: Contract Signing
beat.contract-signing.description: The match is made official at a table, with a pen and a lot of tension.

beat.entrance.name: Entrance
beat.entrance.description: A full entrance with music, lights and a walk to the ring that the crowd can savour.

beat.interview.name: Interview
beat.interview.description: Someone answers questions from an interviewer, backstage or at ringside.

beat.locker-room-interview.name: Locker-Room Interview
beat.locker-room-interview.description: An interviewer catches someone in the locker room for a few quick words, away from the crowd.

beat.medical-update.name: Medical Update
beat.medical-update.description: Someone reports on how a hurt wrestler is doing, with the wrestler in shot or not.

beat.office-meeting.name: Office Meeting
beat.office-meeting.description: The boss calls people into the office to hand down a decision, a warning or a match.

beat.parking-lot-attack.name: Car Park Ambush
beat.parking-lot-attack.description: One side waits by the cars and jumps the other as they arrive. Raw, fast and caught on a handheld camera.

beat.promo.name: Promo
beat.promo.description: One side takes the microphone and talks to the crowd, a rival or the camera.

beat.pull-apart.name: Pull-Apart
beat.pull-apart.description: Officials and staff rush in to separate people who will not stop fighting.

beat.staredown.name: Staredown
beat.staredown.description: Rivals stand face to face and say nothing. The crowd fills the silence.

beat.video-package.name: Video Package
beat.video-package.description: A pre-recorded piece about the people featured: where they came from and what they want.

beat.war-of-words.name: War of Words
beat.war-of-words.description: Two sides trade insults on the microphone, each trying to have the last word.

template.ambush.name: Ambush
template.ambush.description: One side jumps the other until someone pulls them apart.

template.backstage-interview.name: Backstage Interview
template.backstage-interview.description: An interviewer catches someone in the locker room for a few words, away from the crowd.

template.backstage-plot.name: Backstage Plot
template.backstage-plot.description: A scene backstage that sets up trouble, and words to follow.

template.feud-opener.name: Feud Opener
template.feud-opener.description: Two rivals meet, trade words and come to blows.

template.hype-video.name: Hype Video
template.hype-video.description: A video that builds someone up before they arrive.

template.office-summons.name: Office Summons
template.office-summons.description: The boss calls both sides in and makes the match. They don't leave quietly.

template.parking-lot-ambush.name: Car Park Ambush
template.parking-lot-ambush.description: One side waits in the car park and jumps the other as they arrive.

template.sit-down-interview.name: Sit-Down Interview
template.sit-down-interview.description: An interviewer asks the questions, then the guest speaks their mind.

template.solo-promo.name: Solo Promo
template.solo-promo.description: One person talks to the crowd.

template.title-contract.name: Title Contract
template.title-contract.description: The title match is announced, signed and sealed with a stare.

template.victory-lap.name: Victory Lap
template.victory-lap.description: A winner comes out to soak up the cheers and say a few words.

storylines.name: Test Storyline A
storylines.summary: A former champion wants the title back.
